source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Geometric statements are proved from known ones, but a few are accepted without proof at the start; these are axioms.
stages.headlineEnglish: Geometric statements are proved from known ones, but a few are accepted without proof at the start; these are axioms.

stages.headline: Examples: exactly one line passes through two points; from a point on a ray exactly one segment of given length can be laid off.
stages.headlineEnglish: Examples: exactly one line passes through two points; from a point on a ray exactly one segment of given length can be laid off.

stages.headline: The first system of axioms was built by the ancient Greek mathematician Euclid in his «Elements», 3rd century BC.
stages.headlineEnglish: The first system of axioms was built by the ancient Greek mathematician Euclid in his «Elements», 3rd century BC.

stages.solutionSteps: 1. A theorem is proved, an axiom is not.
